2447:2.name: AppBar
2447:2.description: The top header of every Safqah app screen: page title, leading back/close control and trailing actions, with 11 legacy layout types (home greeting with wallet balance, inner screens, deal page, onboarding, modal close). It is the screen-level navigation bar, not a content card.
useWhen: Home/dashboard header with greeting, privacy eye and wallet balance (Type=main screens)
Inner screens and settings pages that need a title, subtitle and back arrow (Type=Inner screens or Small Title)
Deal page navigation with prev/next and share, including the sticky collapsed state on scroll (Type=Deal page, Deal page-collapsing)
Full-screen overlays that only need a title and a close X (Type=Close Icon-white / Close Icon-Black)
dontUseWhen: Showing the deal photo, title and developer at the top of a deal page: use HeaderCard (Base card) under the AppBar
Section navigation between Home/Investments/Wallet/Account: use TabBar
Titling a region inside the page: use Section
Desktop web side navigation: use NavigationRail or AppSidebar (shadcn-style)
2447:2.keyProps: Type (main screens / Inner screens / Small Title / Deal page-detail / Deal page / Large Icons / Deal page-collapsing), Title, Subtitle, Balance, TrailingLabel, showSubtitle, showLeading, showTrailing, showBalance, showProfile, showEyeButton, hideBalance, hasShade, hasDivider
2447:2.a11y: Render as a header landmark with the title as the page h1; icon-only back, close and share buttons need aria-labels (Back / رجوع); the eye button must announce whether the balance is shown or hidden.

4844:107432.name: Header Info
4844:107432.description: Home header variant that extends the main-screens AppBar with a returns summary: greeting, masked wallet balance, total returns and expected profit, amount invested and a View payouts list button. It is the 'Main screens with payouts' row of the AppBar reference.
useWhen: Investor home screen when the user has active investments and returns to show
Entry point from home into the payouts / distribution schedule (Show Payouts list on)
dontUseWhen: Inner screens or deal pages: use AppBar with the matching Type
Building a new portfolio summary from parts: use PortfolioHeader (UserGreeting, WalletChip, ReturnsDisplay)
A single KPI tile: use Stat
4844:107432.a11y: Amounts must be read with currency (324,763 ر.س); the eye toggle announces the hidden state; the payouts button label must describe the destination.

4844:107612.name: Header
4844:107612.description: Product header set (not published to the library) used as the home greeting header and composed inside HeaderCard; State switches between visible and hidden balance and Show Qualified adds the qualified-investor badge. No example image exists, so treat it as a source part rather than a building block.
useWhen: Reproducing the production home header where the balance can be hidden (State=Hide)
Showing the qualified badge for qualified investors (Show Qualified on)
dontUseWhen: New screens: prefer AppBar (Type=main screens) or PortfolioHeader, which are documented and tokenized
Home with returns and payouts: use Header Info
4844:107612.a11y: When State=Hide the masked value must be announced as hidden, not read as asterisks.

2517:30.name: TrendBadge
2517:30.description: Small delta badge showing a percentage change with a green up or red down marker. Used beside a tab label, in portfolio table cells and anywhere a change value needs directional colour.
useWhen: Showing a performance delta on a SegmentedTabItem (HasTrend=true)
Value change column in a portfolio Table (Table / Cell Type=Trend)
Next to a Stat or KeyValue value to show change since last period
dontUseWhen: Status of a deal or issuance: use StatusPill or IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor)
Category labels: use Tag
2517:30.a11y: Do not rely on colour: keep the sign and arrow, and expose text such as 'up 7.6%'; keep the numeric run bidi-isolated in RTL.

2518:62.name: SegmentedTabItem
2518:62.description: One tab of SegmentedTabs: a 16px SemiBold label with an underline when active and an optional TrendBadge. Its state is driven by the parent organism.
useWhen: Inside SegmentedTabs only; set its Label per instance
Adding a delta beside a tab label (HasTrend=true)
dontUseWhen: Standalone: use SegmentedTabs
Bottom navigation items: use BottomNavTabItem
Pill-style value choice: use Segment inside SegmentedControl_2..5
2518:62.a11y: role=tab with aria-selected; do not set State by hand inside an organism or it desyncs from the indicator.

2522:26.name: BottomNavTabItem
2522:26.description: One destination of the bottom TabBar: 24px icon stacked over an 11px label, brand colour when active and muted when inactive. Also the DNA reused by NavRailItem.
useWhen: Inside TabBar or TabBar (3-tab); swap the icon and set the Label per instance
dontUseWhen: Standalone buttons: use IconButton or ActionTile
Desktop side navigation items: use NavRailItem
2522:26.a11y: Active item exposes aria-current=page; the label is always visible so the icon is decorative; touch target at least 44x44.

2527:350.name: TabBar
2527:350.description: Fixed bottom navigation for the four-section Safqah app (Home, Investments, Wallet, Account) with exactly one active tab. The 4-tab IA is future: keep it in designs but do not wire into production until the IA ships.
useWhen: Top-level app navigation on mobile, pinned to the bottom with safe-area padding
Designs for the four-section IA (Home, Investments, Wallet, Account)
dontUseWhen: Current three-section production app: use TabBar (3-tab)
Switching views of the same content inside a screen: use SegmentedTabs
Choosing a value such as Day/Week/Month: use SegmentedControl_3
Tablet and desktop: use NavigationRail or AppSidebar (shadcn-style)
2527:350.keyProps: Active=1/2/3/4, Direction=LTR/RTL (labels set on each nested BottomNavTabItem)
2527:350.a11y: Wrap in a nav landmark; active item aria-current=page; in RTL the first tab sits on the right.

2568:739.name: TabBar (3-tab)
2568:739.description: Bottom navigation for the current three-section Safqah app (Deals, Portfolio, Settings), one tab always active in brand colour.
useWhen: Primary navigation on mobile screens of the shipping app
Any production screen that sits at the top level of a section
dontUseWhen: Four-section IA designs: use TabBar
In-screen view switching: use SegmentedTabs
Inside flows such as checkout or KYC where navigation should be hidden: use AppBar with a back control only
2568:739.a11y: nav landmark with aria-current=page on the active item; keep visible labels.

2523:90.name: SegmentedTabs
2523:90.description: Underline tabs placed directly below the AppBar to switch between two content views of one screen, such as Active vs Completed investments. Navigation-like (changes the view), not a form control.
useWhen: Switching between sibling views on one screen (Active / Completed investments)
Portfolio views that show a delta on a tab (SegmentedTabItem HasTrend=true)
dontUseWhen: Moving between app sections: use TabBar or TabBar (3-tab)
Picking a filter or range value that updates the same view (Day / Week / Month): use SegmentedControl_2..5
More than 2 to 3 options: use Select
2523:90.a11y: role=tablist with tabs and associated tabpanels; arrow keys move between tabs.

2542:2.name: DragHandle
2542:2.description: The grabber pill at the top of a BottomSheet that signals the sheet can be dragged down to dismiss.
useWhen: Top of any BottomSheet that is dismissible (BottomSheet showHandle on)
Bottom-sheet menu and Action sheet patterns
dontUseWhen: Modal or Drawer: they have no drag-to-dismiss
Blocking sheets that must not be dismissed: hide it with showHandle off
2542:2.a11y: Decorative; always provide an accessible close or cancel action since drag is not available to all users.

2615:13.name: SheetHeader
2615:13.description: Shared overlay header with title, optional subtitle and optional close X, reused by BottomSheet, Modal and Drawer.
useWhen: Header of a BottomSheet, Modal or Drawer (toggle via showHeader on the shell)
Hiding the close for destructive confirms (showClose off)
dontUseWhen: Screen header: use AppBar
Titling a region in a page: use Section
2615:13.a11y: Title is the dialog's accessible name (aria-labelledby); close button labelled Close / إغلاق.

2628:14.name: Sheet Content / Text
2628:14.description: Ready content block for overlay slots: heading, paragraphs and an inline link. The default Content of BottomSheet, used for explanatory sheets such as 'About the developer'.
useWhen: Explaining a term, fee or developer in a BottomSheet or Modal
Short informational sheet with one confirm action
dontUseWhen: Long legal text: use a full page
Breakdowns with amounts: use Sheet Content / Summary
2628:14.keyProps: Direction=LTR/RTL (swap the RTL variant for Arabic sheets; the slot default is LTR)
2628:14.a11y: Keep heading order under the sheet title; the link must be a real link with descriptive text.

2633:157.name: SheetFooter
2633:157.description: Shared overlay action area: primary button with optional secondary and an optional overflow menu, stacked (mobile sheets, modals) or in a row (drawers).
useWhen: Confirm / Cancel actions at the bottom of a BottomSheet or Modal (Layout=Stacked)
Drawer footer with Apply, Reset and overflow (Layout=Row)
dontUseWhen: Page-level button groups: use ButtonGroup
Pure navigation drawers: turn showFooter off on Drawer
2633:157.a11y: Primary action first in reading order; reserve the home-indicator safe area; overflow needs an aria-label.

2646:149.name: Sheet Content / Summary
2646:149.description: Overlay content block of KeyValue rows, a Divider and an emphasised total, for receipts and breakdowns.
useWhen: Investment confirmation summary before paying
Fee and return breakdown in a sheet or modal
Contextual detail in a Drawer
dontUseWhen: Many comparable records: use a Table
Inline in a page: use List (Style=Description) or KeyValue
2646:149.a11y: Expose rows as a description list (term/value); read amounts with currency after the number.

2649:137.name: Sheet Content / Form
2649:137.description: Overlay content block with Input and TextArea fields for collecting a few structured values, or filters in a Drawer.
useWhen: Short data entry tied to the current screen (one to three fields)
Filter panel in a trailing Drawer
dontUseWhen: Long or multi-step forms: use a full page with Stepper
Entering an amount: use Sheet Content / Amount
2649:137.a11y: Every field keeps a visible label; move focus to the first field on open; errors announced inline.

2650:98.name: Sheet Content / Amount
2650:98.description: Overlay content block with an Input Amount field and a Slider for entering an investment or transfer value.
useWhen: Entering an investment amount from a deal page in a sheet
Withdraw or transfer amount entry with a min/max range
dontUseWhen: Full calculator with returns: use Investment Calculator
Quantity of units: use NumericStepper
2650:98.a11y: Slider and field stay in sync and both are keyboard operable; announce min, max and currency.

2650:293.name: Sheet Content / Empty
2650:293.description: Overlay content block wrapping EmptyState for zero-data or first-run cases inside a sheet or modal.
useWhen: A sheet that lists items but has none yet
First-run explanation inside a sheet
dontUseWhen: Full-screen empty pages: use EmptyState directly
2650:293.a11y: Illustration is decorative; the message and the single action carry the meaning.

2652:296.name: Sheet Content / List
2652:296.description: Overlay content block of rows with icon, title/subtitle and a Tag chip, for pickers, selection and navigation destinations in drawers.
useWhen: Picking one item from a short list in a sheet
Navigation destinations in a leading Drawer
dontUseWhen: A list of commands on mobile: use Action sheet or Bottom-sheet menu
Radio/checkbox choice with a clear selected state: use SelectionList
2652:296.a11y: Each row is one focusable target with its full text as the accessible name.

2686:22.name: Sheet Content / Media
2686:22.description: Overlay content block with a 16:9 video or image and caption, built to pair with the Modal xl size.
useWhen: Explainer video or image gallery in a web Modal (Size=xl)
dontUseWhen: Deal photo gallery on the deal page: use HeaderCard (Base card)
Browsable promos: use Carousel
2686:22.a11y: Video needs captions and controls; images need alt text; caption stays as visible text.

2699:12.name: Sheet Content / Blank
2699:12.description: Empty placeholder for the overlay Content slot ('Your content here'), the default for Modal and Drawer, meant to be swapped for a real component.
useWhen: Starting point before swapping in your own component
Never shipped as-is
dontUseWhen: Final designs: swap for Sheet Content / Text, List, Summary, Form, Amount, Empty, Media or a custom component
2699:12.a11y: Not applicable; it must be replaced before handoff.

2634:273.name: BottomSheet
2634:273.description: Mobile modal surface that slides up from the bottom over a scrim for one short, focused task without leaving the screen: drag handle, SheetHeader, swappable Content slot and SheetFooter. The default overlay for Safqah mobile.
useWhen: Confirming an investment or reviewing a summary before paying
Entering an amount or a short form tied to the current screen
Explaining a term or developer in context
Re-prompt or permission reminders on mobile
dontUseWhen: Centered blocking confirm on desktop/web: use Modal, or Dialog for a one-line confirm
Side panel for navigation or filters: use Drawer
A floating list of commands: use Menu (or Action sheet on mobile)
Long or multi-step flows: use a full page with Stepper
2634:273.keyProps: showHandle, showHeader, showFooter, Content (instance swap), Direction=LTR/RTL
2634:273.a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal, labelled by the SheetHeader title; trap focus and restore it on close; provide a close or cancel besides drag; never stack two sheets.

2681:503.name: Modal
2681:503.description: Centered overlay card on a dimmed scrim that blocks the page until the user acts; the web/desktop twin of BottomSheet sharing SheetHeader, SheetFooter and the content library, in four widths. Reserved for critical interruptions.
useWhen: Critical or irreversible actions on web (delete, discard changes)
Information the flow cannot continue without (sign in to save a deal)
Media-rich explainer video or gallery on web (Size=xl with Sheet Content / Media)
Back-office forms or summaries that need focus (Size=md/lg)
dontUseWhen: On mobile: use BottomSheet
Simple one-line yes/no confirm: use Dialog
Promos, announcements or upsells during checkout: do not interrupt; use Banner or inline content
Side panels for filters or detail: use Drawer
2681:503.keyProps: showHeader, showFooter, Content (instance swap), Size=sm/md/lg/xl, Direction=LTR/RTL
2681:503.a11y: role=dialog aria-modal, focus trapped and returned to the trigger, Esc closes routine modals; for destructive confirms disable scrim/Esc dismissal and require an explicit choice.

2706:385.name: Drawer
2706:385.description: Full-height side panel that slides in from the leading or trailing edge for navigation, filters or contextual detail while the page stays in context. Shares SheetHeader, SheetFooter (Row layout) and the content library with BottomSheet and Modal.
useWhen: Filters in back-office tables, tweaked while results update (trailing side, Form content, Apply/Reset footer)
Record detail beside a list (trailing side, Summary content)
Temporary navigation on tablet or deep hierarchies (leading side, List content, footer off)
dontUseWhen: A short list of actions: use Menu or ActionList
A focused mobile task: use BottomSheet
A centered confirm: use Modal or Dialog
Persistent desktop navigation: use NavigationRail or AppSidebar (shadcn-style)
2706:385.keyProps: showHeader, showFooter, Content (instance swap), Side=left/right (physical; mirrors with Direction), Direction=LTR/RTL
2706:385.a11y: Modal drawer: role=dialog, focus trap, Esc and scrim close; persistent drawer: no trap, use a complementary or nav landmark. One drawer at a time.

2723:50.name: BreadcrumbItem
2723:50.description: One segment of a Breadcrumb trail: a muted link to an ancestor level, brand and underlined on hover, or the bold non-link current page.
useWhen: Inside Breadcrumb; set Label per item, showIcon on the root (home) item, State=current on the last
dontUseWhen: Standalone links in text: use Link
Step labels in a flow: use Stepper
2723:50.a11y: Current item uses aria-current=page and is not a link; home icon item still needs a text label.

2725:20.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
2725:20.description: The chevron between breadcrumb items, pointing in the reading direction and mirroring in RTL.
useWhen: Between BreadcrumbItems inside Breadcrumb
dontUseWhen: As a generic chevron or arrow: use the Syntropy icon directly

2726:168.name: Breadcrumb
2726:168.description: Single-line trail from the top of the hierarchy to the current page (Home > Investments > Active Deals > Deal #1024) for orientation in deep web and back-office structures. A secondary aid, never the primary navigation.
useWhen: Back-office and web pages three or more levels deep
Users landing deep from search or a shared link
Long trails that must stay on one line (Type=collapsed with an ellipsis)
dontUseWhen: Flat one or two level structures: omit it
Sequential flows like KYC or checkout: use Stepper
Mobile app screens: use AppBar with BackButton
As the only navigation: pair with NavigationRail, AppSidebar (shadcn-style) or TabBar
2726:168.a11y: nav aria-label=Breadcrumb with an ordered list; last item aria-current=page; never wrap or truncate labels.

2734:20.name: PaginationItem
2734:20.description: A 36px page number cell (or the ellipsis) used to build Pagination; current page gets the brand fill.
useWhen: Inside Pagination or a custom pagination row; Label holds the page number or the ellipsis
dontUseWhen: Carousel position dots: use PageIndicator
Step numbers: use StepIndicator
2734:20.a11y: aria-label 'Page 3', aria-current=page on the current item; Western digits per Syntropy number rules.

2735:44.name: PaginationArrow
2735:44.description: Previous or next 36px button in Pagination, disabled on the first and last page instead of hidden.
useWhen: Inside Pagination, or alone for compact prev/next paging
dontUseWhen: Back navigation: use BackButton
Carousel arrows on media: use IconButton
2735:44.a11y: aria-label Previous page / Next page; disabled state uses aria-disabled; chevrons mirror in RTL.

2736:120.name: Pagination
2736:120.description: Splits long ordered result sets into pages with prev/next and page numbers, in numbered, compact (Page X of Y) and table footer (rows per page + range) layouts. Main use is back-office tables of deals, investors and transactions.
useWhen: Back-office Table footers (Type=table with rows-per-page Select and '1-10 of 200')
Long ordered lists where users need an exact page or total (Type=numbered)
Narrow cards, toolbars or mobile (Type=compact)
dontUseWhen: Continuous exploratory feeds such as updates: use infinite scroll or a Load more Button
Lists that fit on one screen: omit it
Carousel position: use PageIndicator
2736:120.a11y: nav aria-label=Pagination; current page aria-current; keep a single line; use Western digits (0-9) even in RTL, overriding the page guide's Arabic-Indic note.

2746:17.name: StepIndicator
2746:17.description: 28px step circle of a Stepper: check when completed, brand number when current, outlined number when upcoming, error fill with ! when the step failed.
useWhen: Inside Stepper; set Number and State per step
dontUseWhen: Timelines of deal events: use TimelineNode
Counts on icons: use Badge Count
2746:17.a11y: State must be announced in text (completed, current, error), not only by colour or icon.

2747:16.name: StepConnector
2747:16.description: Line between step indicators, brand when complete and muted when incomplete, horizontal or vertical, stretching to fill the gap.
useWhen: Inside Stepper between StepIndicators; the connector before the current step is complete
dontUseWhen: Visual separators: use Divider
Progress amounts: use ProgressBar

2752:66.name: Stepper
2752:66.description: Process stepper that shows an ordered multi-step flow (Account, Identity, Bank details, Review) with completed, current and upcoming steps. It shows progress through a task; it is not a numeric input.
useWhen: Onboarding, KYC, guided investment or checkout flows with 3 to 5 ordered steps
Showing total length and progress up front (Orientation=horizontal on wide layouts)
Long labels or narrow columns (Orientation=vertical)
dontUseWhen: Incrementing a quantity with minus and plus: use NumericStepper
Hierarchy or location: use Breadcrumb
Safqah KYC checklist screens: use KYCStep
A single short form: no stepper
2752:66.keyProps: Orientation=horizontal/vertical, Direction=LTR/RTL (set each nested StepIndicator State and Number)
2752:66.a11y: Ordered list with the current step marked aria-current=step; progress also stated in text (Step 2 of 4); progress flows right to left in RTL.

2772:154.name: BackButton
2772:154.description: Preset over Button/IconButton (Variant=tertiary) for returning to the previous screen or step, with a mirrored arrow (Back / رجوع) and an On-media white variant for hero images.
useWhen: Leading slot of a header or inline above content on detail screens and wizard steps
Back over a deal hero photo or dark header (Emphasis=On-media)
Dense headers (Type=Icon only)
dontUseWhen: Showing location across levels: use Breadcrumb
Switching sibling views: use SegmentedTabs or TabBar
Dismissing an overlay: use the SheetHeader close
When the AppBar already shows a back arrow: keep one back affordance per screen
2772:154.a11y: Icon only needs aria-label Back / رجوع; keep the focus ring; hide rather than disable on the first screen of a flow.

2852:101.name: NavRailItem
2852:101.description: One destination in NavigationRail or AppSidebar: Stacked icon over label when collapsed or Row icon plus title when expanded, with active pill, badge, submenu chevron and overflow action options.
useWhen: Inside NavigationRail or AppSidebar (shadcn-style); swap Icon and set the label
Showing a count or dot on a destination (Show badge)
Expandable group with children (Show chevron)
dontUseWhen: Mobile bottom navigation: use BottomNavTabItem
Rows in a page list: use ListItem
Overflow command rows: use MenuItem
2852:101.keyProps: Icon (instance swap), Show label, Show badge, Show chevron, Show action, Layout=Stacked/Row, State=active/inactive/hover, Direction=LTR/RTL
2852:101.a11y: aria-current=page when active; collapsed items need a tooltip and aria-label; badge counts announced (3 new).

2887:874.name: Brand / Safqah Wordmark (Dark)
2887:874.description: The real Safqah wordmark (صفقة المالية), dark variant, pinned at the top of the navigation rail and sidebar.
useWhen: Header of NavigationRail or AppSidebar (shadcn-style)
dontUseWhen: Other brand placements (splash, marketing, documents): use SafqahLogo
2887:874.a11y: Provide alt text 'Safqah' / 'صفقة' or link it to home with that name.

2888:874.name: Icon / nav-toggle-menu
2888:874.description: Hamburger glyph that expands a collapsed NavigationRail.
useWhen: Toggle control in a collapsed NavigationRail or AppSidebar header
dontUseWhen: Opening a menu of commands: use MenuTrigger (Glyph=hamburger)
Collapsing an expanded rail: use Icon / nav-toggle-chevron
2888:874.a11y: Wrap in a button with aria-label Expand navigation and aria-expanded=false.

2888:878.name: Icon / nav-toggle-chevron
2888:878.description: Chevron glyph that collapses an expanded NavigationRail; mirror it for RTL.
useWhen: Collapse control in an expanded NavigationRail header
dontUseWhen: Back navigation: use BackButton
Expanding a collapsed rail: use Icon / nav-toggle-menu
2888:878.a11y: Button with aria-label Collapse navigation and aria-expanded=true.

2911:1119.name: Icon / chevron-down-sm
2911:1119.description: Small chevron-down affordance marking an expandable NavRailItem with a submenu.
useWhen: Trailing glyph of a NavRailItem group (Show chevron)
dontUseWhen: Accordion toggles: AccordionItem has its own arrowhead
Select fields: use Select
2911:1119.a11y: Decorative; the parent item carries aria-expanded.

2938:3105.name: Icon / more-horizontal
2938:3105.description: Horizontal ellipsis glyph for an overflow action on navigation items (for example on project rows in the sidebar).
useWhen: Overflow action on a NavRailItem (Show action)
dontUseWhen: A standalone overflow trigger: use MenuTrigger (Glyph=meatball)
Row actions in tables: use Table / ActionCell
2938:3105.a11y: Wrap in a button with aria-label More options and aria-haspopup=menu.

2956:4525.name: AppSidebar (shadcn-style)
2956:4525.description: Published shadcn-style application sidebar for web: workspace switcher, search, grouped NavRailItems (Platform, Projects), pinned settings/help and a user footer, expanded or collapsed. The library-ready desktop navigation shell.
useWhen: Web and back-office app shells with grouped destinations and a workspace switcher
Desktop layouts that need search plus account menu in the sidebar
Variant=Floating or Inset when the sidebar should sit as a card beside content
dontUseWhen: Mobile: use TabBar (3-tab)
Simple rail without workspace or search: use NavigationRail
Temporary navigation over content: use Drawer
2956:4525.a11y: nav landmark with group labels as headings; collapse toggle exposes aria-expanded; sits on the right edge in RTL.

2959:4538.name: NavRail / TeamSwitcher
2959:4538.description: Sidebar header block with the Safqah app mark, workspace name (Investor workspace) and a chevron to switch workspace.
useWhen: Top of AppSidebar (shadcn-style) when users can switch between workspaces or roles
dontUseWhen: Single-workspace apps: use Brand / Safqah Wordmark (Dark) alone
Choosing a form value: use Select
2959:4538.a11y: Button with aria-haspopup=menu and the current workspace in its name.

2959:4550.name: NavRail / NavUser
2959:4550.description: Sidebar footer block with the signed-in user's avatar, name and email and a chevron opening the account menu.
useWhen: Bottom of AppSidebar (shadcn-style) or NavigationRail for account and sign-out access
dontUseWhen: Profile summaries in a page: use Avatar with ListItem
Investor profile headers in back-office: build from Avatar and KeyValue
2959:4550.a11y: Button with aria-haspopup=menu; avatar decorative when the name is shown.

2855:175.name: NavigationRail
2855:175.description: Persistent vertical navigation for tablet and desktop, the rail counterpart of the bottom TabBar: wordmark and toggle, grouped NavRailItems with badges and submenus, account pinned at the bottom; Expanded (about 240px) or Collapsed (about 80px).
useWhen: Tablet and desktop layouts with 3 to 7 top-level destinations
Web investor portal using the same destinations as the mobile TabBar
Mode=Collapsed to reclaim width on data-heavy screens
dontUseWhen: Mobile: use TabBar (3-tab)
Deep or temporary hierarchies: use Drawer
Needing a published library shell with workspace switcher and search: use AppSidebar (shadcn-style)
2855:175.keyProps: Show header, Show group labels, Show badges, Submenu open, Show footer, Variant=Standard/Floating/Inset, Mode=Expanded/Collapsed, Direction=LTR/RTL
2855:175.a11y: nav landmark, exactly one aria-current=page item, tooltips for collapsed labels; anchored to the right edge in RTL.

4011:1102.name: Scrollbar
4011:1102.description: Track and thumb for scrollable areas, overlay or gutter model, thin or default, with idle, hover and dragging states.
useWhen: Inside ScrollContainer to show scroll position on web and back-office panels
Model=gutter where content must not sit under the thumb (tables)
dontUseWhen: Native mobile scroll: hide it (ScrollContainer showScrollbar off)
Progress values: use ProgressBar
4011:1102.a11y: Visual only; the scroll region itself must be keyboard scrollable (tabindex and a label).

4012:1050.name: Fade
4012:1050.description: Edge gradient mask hinting that more content lies beyond the start or end of a scroll area; its stops are hardcoded from bg/surface and bg/elevated.
useWhen: Edges of horizontal card rails and long lists (ScrollContainer fadeStart / fadeEnd)
dontUseWhen: Under sticky headers or above sticky footers: use Scroll shadow
Image overlays: use the media's own scrim
4012:1050.a11y: Decorative; never fade over interactive content that must stay readable.

4013:1046.name: Scroll shadow
4013:1046.description: Shadow divider shown under a sticky header or above a sticky footer once content scrolls beneath it; reuses the Shadow / sm style.
useWhen: Sticky header or footer inside ScrollContainer, sheets and long pages
dontUseWhen: Static separators: use Divider
Scroll edge hints on rails: use Fade

4014:201382.name: Pull-to-refresh
4014:201382.description: Mobile pull-to-refresh indicator that swaps a spinner through idle, pulling and refreshing states at the top of a scroll area.
useWhen: Refreshing feeds such as deals, portfolio or updates on mobile
dontUseWhen: Web and back-office: use an explicit refresh Button
Initial page load: use Skeleton blocks
4014:201382.a11y: Offer an alternative refresh action; announce 'Refreshing' and completion via a live region.

4015:1061.name: Scroll content
4015:1061.description: Placeholder content for the ScrollContainer Content slot, to be swapped for the real list or rail.
useWhen: Default slot filler before swapping in real content
dontUseWhen: Final designs: swap in List, ActionList, Carousel or your own component

4015:1157.name: ScrollContainer
4015:1157.description: Clipped scrollable area that assembles Scrollbar, edge Fades and Scroll shadows around a swappable Content slot, vertical or horizontal, with RTL origin handling.
useWhen: Horizontal card rails such as deal or poster strips with fades at the edges
Long lists inside fixed-height panels with sticky header or footer
Back-office panels that need a visible scrollbar
dontUseWhen: Paged slides with an indicator: use Carousel
Whole-page scroll: let the screen scroll natively
4015:1157.keyProps: fadeStart, fadeEnd, stickyHeader, stickyFooter, showScrollbar, Content (instance swap), Axis=vertical/horizontal, Direction=LTR/RTL
4015:1157.a11y: Scroll region must be focusable with an accessible name; in RTL horizontal scroll starts at the right and the vertical scrollbar sits on the left.

4256:1443.name: Segment
4256:1443.description: One option inside a SegmentedControl: label, optional icon, count and dot, with selection shown by weight and colour while the parent's thumb provides the fill.
useWhen: Inside SegmentedControl_2..5; set exactly one nested Segment to State=selected
Icon-only options (Has label off) or filter counts (Show count)
dontUseWhen: Standalone buttons: use Button or ButtonGroup
Tabs: use SegmentedTabItem
4256:1443.keyProps: Label, Has label, Icon, Has icon, Show count, Count, Show Dot, Show Dot right, State=unselected/selected/hover/pressed/focus/disabled/selected-disabled, Size=sm/md/lg
4256:1443.a11y: role=radio with aria-checked; md/lg meet the 44pt target; icon-only segments need aria-label.

4258:1461.name: SegmentedControl_3
4258:1461.description: Three-option pill single-select control (Day / Week / Month) that filters or toggles the same view. A radio group in a pill, not navigation.
useWhen: Chart or returns range switches (Day / Week / Month)
Filtering a list in place (All / Active / Closed)
Choosing a mode inside a card or calculator
dontUseWhen: Moving between different screens or views: use SegmentedTabs or TabBar
Binary on/off: use Switch
Long value lists: use Select
Two or four or five options: use SegmentedControl_2, SegmentedControl_4 or SegmentedControl_5
4258:1461.keyProps: Style=pill-thumb/solid/dark/minimal, Size=sm/md/lg, Direction=LTR/RTL (selection = one nested Segment State=selected)
4258:1461.a11y: role=radiogroup with an accessible label; arrow keys move selection; labels truncate, never scroll; order reverses in RTL.

4260:1202.name: SegmentedControl_2
4260:1202.description: Two-option pill single-select control (Monthly / Yearly) for toggling a value on the same view.
useWhen: Two mutually exclusive modes such as Monthly / Yearly or Gross / Net
Compact toggles inside cards and calculators
dontUseWhen: Simple on/off: use Switch
Switching content views under the AppBar: use SegmentedTabs
Three or more options: use SegmentedControl_3, _4 or _5
4260:1202.a11y: role=radiogroup; selection must not rely on colour alone (weight change plus thumb).

4260:1351.name: SegmentedControl_4
4260:1351.description: Four-option pill single-select control (Day / Week / Month / Year) for range or filter choices on the same view.
useWhen: Four range options on a chart or report
Four-way filters on a list
dontUseWhen: Navigation between sections: use TabBar
Long labels that would truncate badly: use Select

4260:1536.name: SegmentedControl_5
4260:1536.description: Five-option pill single-select control with short labels (1D / 1W / 1M / 1Y / All), typically for chart time ranges.
useWhen: Chart time-range pickers with abbreviated labels
Five short filter options
dontUseWhen: More than five options or long labels: use Select
Scrolling tab rows: use SegmentedTabs or TabBar
4260:1536.a11y: role=radiogroup; abbreviated labels need full aria-labels (1 week).

3013:95390.name: CardDeal
3013:95390.description: The investment deal card that lists or spotlights a Safqah opportunity: media, qualified badge, status, title, highlights, ROI and term, as a Hero card or a compact Row, across Available, Reserved, Invested and Closed states.
useWhen: Deals feed or home featured deal (Layout=Hero)
Dense deal lists such as portfolio or closed deals (Layout=Row)
Showing qualified-only deals to qualified users (Qualified on)
dontUseWhen: Top of a single deal's detail page: use Base card (HeaderCard)
Updates about a deal or project: use NewsCard or NewsCard / Poster
Guidance or advisor messages: use CardInfo
A quick action or CTA nudge: use ActionTile or ActionPrompt
3013:95390.keyProps: Layout=Hero/Row, State=Available/Reserved/Invested/Closed, Qualified, Show media, Show status, Show highlights, Show ROI, Show arrow, Show success, Show Upper left arrow, Media image (instance swap), Direction=RTL/LTR
3013:95390.a11y: Whole card is one link named by the deal title; status and ROI read as text; Closed state must not rely on dimming alone; never show the qualified badge to standard users.

3019:148.name: CardDeal / Metric
3019:148.description: Label plus value line on a deal card, such as ROI 12-29% or Term 6-12 months.
useWhen: ROI and term lines inside CardDeal
dontUseWhen: Key-value rows outside the card: use KeyValue
Large KPI numbers: use Stat
3019:148.a11y: Read label and value together; percentages labelled with نسبة in Arabic per content rules.

3036:316.name: CardDeal / Headline
3036:316.description: Deal title text atom on CardDeal.
useWhen: Deal name inside CardDeal
dontUseWhen: Section or page titles: use Section or AppBar
3036:316.a11y: Serves as the card link's accessible name; use a heading level that fits the list.

3040:332.name: CardDeal / Highlights
3040:332.description: Muted one-line feature summary on a deal card (High yield, 14-yr track record, 3x collateral).
useWhen: Short selling points under the deal title in CardDeal
dontUseWhen: Bullet lists in content: use List (Style=Bulleted)
Category chips: use Tag
3040:332.a11y: Muted text must still meet AA contrast; separators read naturally.

3048:330.name: CardDeal / Media
3048:330.description: Deal image surface: Hero (16:9, large radius) or Thumb (square) used in Row layout.
useWhen: Deal photo in CardDeal; swap the image fill per deal
dontUseWhen: Deal page gallery: use Base card (HeaderCard)
Update posters: use NewsCard / Poster Media
3048:330.a11y: Decorative when the title is present (empty alt); otherwise describe the project.

3085:61.name: Goal / Headline
3085:61.description: Goal card title atom with optional leading icon (Your investment goal / تتبع هدفك الاستثماري). Status wip.
useWhen: Title of GoalActivate or GoalTracker
dontUseWhen: Generic region titles: use Section
3085:61.a11y: Heading for the goal card; icon decorative.

3086:57.name: Goal / Illustration
3086:57.description: Placeholder network/map illustration for the goal CTA card; swap with the real localized KSA-map art before shipping. Status wip.
useWhen: Visual of GoalActivate
dontUseWhen: Empty states: use EmptyState illustrations
Shipping as-is: replace with final art

3090:97.name: Goal / Summary
3090:97.description: Goal total block: large radial ring, 'Total goal progress' label and the running total amount. Status wip.
useWhen: Footer of GoalTracker showing overall progress
dontUseWhen: Generic KPIs: use Stat
Linear progress: use ProgressBar
3090:97.a11y: Expose progress as text (amount and percent); the ring is decorative.

3103:1296.name: Goal / PhaseRow
3103:1296.description: One milestone row in GoalTracker: ring with percent, month title, amount and chevron; green filled when achieved, light when pending. Status wip.
useWhen: Each milestone in GoalTracker (Percent=+100% / 100% / 50% / 0%)
dontUseWhen: Generic list rows: use ListItem
Deal lifecycle events: use DealTimeline
3103:1296.a11y: Keep the percent and status text on every row; do not rely on green vs grey.

3113:2866.name: Goal / Amount
3113:2866.description: Number plus riyal symbol atom used in goal cards, in three sizes and Default, Inverse or Brand tone. Status wip.
useWhen: Amounts inside Goal / PhaseRow and Goal / Summary
dontUseWhen: Amounts elsewhere in Safqah: use MoneyAmount
3113:2866.a11y: The riyal glyph needs a text equivalent (ر.س / SAR) for screen readers.

3091:392.name: GoalActivate
3091:392.description: Pre-activation goal CTA card with illustration, headline, body and a Button inviting the investor to set an investment goal. Status wip.
useWhen: Before the user has a goal (Phase=Begining)
Setup started but unfinished (Phase=Started)
Informational goal card (Phase=Static)
dontUseWhen: An active goal with milestones: use GoalTracker
Generic CTA nudges such as completing verification: use ActionPrompt
3091:392.a11y: One clear button label; illustration decorative.

3104:1750.name: GoalTracker
3104:1750.description: Active goal card listing milestone phase rows and a total progress summary, in Overachieved, Complete, Active and Early states. Status wip.
useWhen: After the investor activates a goal, on home or the goal center
Showing milestone progress by month with a running total
dontUseWhen: No goal or zero milestones: use GoalActivate
Portfolio returns summary: use PortfolioHeader
3104:1750.a11y: Rows in a list with status text; lead with the nearest milestone; progress as text, not colour only.

3133:738.name: CardAction / Label
3133:738.description: Title plus optional supporting info text atom shared by ActionTile and ActionPrompt.
useWhen: Text inside ActionTile (Size=sm) or ActionPrompt (Size=md)
dontUseWhen: List row text: use Content
CardInfo text: use CardInfo / Content
3133:738.keyProps: Title (text), Info (text), Show info, Size=sm/md, Direction=LTR/RTL
3133:738.a11y: Title forms the action's accessible name; keep info short.

3138:1144.name: ActionTile
3138:1144.description: Compact quick-action tile (icon plus short label) for dashboard shortcut grids or as a horizontal row with supporting info, with Default, Selected and Disabled states.
useWhen: Home quick actions grid such as Deposit, Withdraw, Statements (Style=Vertical)
Shortcut rows with one-line info (Style=Horizontal)
Choosing one option among tiles (State=Selected)
dontUseWhen: A nudge with description and a button: use ActionPrompt
Settings rows grouped in a card: use ListItem inside ActionList
Informational guidance: use CardInfo
Deals: use CardDeal
3138:1144.keyProps: Icon (instance swap), Size=Small/Default, Style=Vertical/Horizontal, State=Default/Selected/Disabled, Direction=LTR/RTL
3138:1144.a11y: Button or link role named by the label; Selected exposed via aria-pressed or aria-checked, not tint alone; icon decorative.

3137:1171.name: ActionPrompt
3137:1171.description: Larger CTA card with an icon badge, title, description and a Button that nudges the user to one action, such as completing verification, toned by priority.
useWhen: Must-do tasks such as completing KYC or adding a bank account (Tone=Warning)
Brand nudges such as enabling notifications (Tone=Brand)
Confirming completion with a next step (Tone=Success)
dontUseWhen: Simple shortcuts: use ActionTile
Information without a button: use CardInfo
Severity or system messages: use Alert or Banner
Goal setup: use GoalActivate
3137:1171.a11y: Button label states the action; tone conveyed by text, not icon colour only.

3190:1178.name: CardInfo / Content
3190:1178.description: Title (SemiBold 13) plus description (Regular 13) text atom of CardInfo.
useWhen: Text block inside CardInfo
dontUseWhen: List rows: use Content
Action cards: use CardAction / Label
3190:1178.a11y: Toned text must keep AA contrast against the card surface.

3200:1066.name: CardInfo
3200:1066.description: Standalone informational card with a circular icon or advisor avatar badge, title, description and chevron, themed by tone. Used for help prompts, relationship-manager cards, tips and status notes that tap through.
useWhen: Help card (Type=Icon, Tone=Brand) such as 'Need any help with your investments?'
Relationship manager or advisor card (Type=Avatar)
Persistent status notes such as identity verified (Tone=Success) or document needed (Tone=Warning)
dontUseWhen: Transient or severity messages: use Toast, Alert or Banner
A CTA with a button: use ActionPrompt
A row inside a settings list: use ListItem
Deals: use CardDeal
3200:1066.a11y: Whole card is one link or button; tone carried by the text; avatar alt is the person's name or decorative if named in the title.

3210:738.name: Content
3210:738.description: Shared text block for rows and cards (Material anatomy): overline, title, supporting description plus optional value, metadata, badge, switch, rating and tags. Used by ListItem, SelectRow, List rows, AccordionItem, Carousel / Slide and NewsCard.
useWhen: Text area of any list row or slide that must stay consistent with ListItem
Building a new row molecule from the system's text block
dontUseWhen: Long body copy: use plain text styles
Card-specific text: use CardInfo / Content or CardAction / Label
3210:738.keyProps: Title, Description, Show description, Overline, Show overline, Value, Show value, Metadata, Show metadata, Show badge, Show switch, Show rating, Show tags, Show top-left-item, Show top-right-item, Size=Lg/Md/Sm, Direction=LTR/RTL
3210:738.a11y: Title first in reading order; muted supporting text must meet AA.

3212:1071.name: ListItem
3212:1071.description: The universal single row: leading icon, title with optional description and exactly one trailing affordance (chevron, Switch, value, Tag label or action Button). It is the row, not the list.
useWhen: Settings and account rows that navigate (Has chevron) or toggle (Has toggle)
Data rows showing a value such as balance
Rows inside ActionList, Drawer or sheet content
dontUseWhen: Grouping rows with header, dividers and footer: use ActionList
Choosing among options with radio or checkbox: use SelectRow inside SelectionList
Rich standalone content: use CardInfo or CardAction
Titling a region: use Section
3212:1071.keyProps: Has leading, Has label, Has value, Has action, Has toggle, Has chevron, Has divider, Leading icon (instance swap), State=Default/Hover/Pressed/Selected/Disabled, Direction=LTR/RTL
3212:1071.a11y: Whole row is one target; with a toggle the Switch is the control and is labelled by the title; one trailing slot per row.

3222:1092.name: ActionList
3222:1092.description: Grouped list container that stacks ListItem rows under a section header with dividers (last off) and an optional footer hint, as a rounded card or plain edge-to-edge. The settings-screen building block.
useWhen: Settings sections such as Account, Notifications, Privacy (Style=Grouped)
Account menus and payment methods lists
Edge-to-edge lists in full-width layouts (Style=Plain)
dontUseWhen: A single row: use ListItem
Choosing an option: use SelectionList
Read-only content lists (bullets, key-value): use List
Floating command lists: use Menu
3222:1092.keyProps: Has header, Has footer, Style=Grouped/Plain, Direction=LTR/RTL
3222:1092.a11y: Render as a list with the header as its label (aria-labelledby); footer text linked via aria-describedby.

3251:1525.name: List
3251:1525.description: Read-only content list in six display styles: Plain, Divided, Inset, Bulleted, Numbered and Description (key-value with total). For presenting information, not for navigation or choice.
useWhen: Feature or benefit bullets on deal or onboarding pages (Style=Bulleted)
Ordered how-to steps (Style=Numbered)
Amount breakdowns with a total such as total invested, profit, net value (Style=Description)
Static text lists (Plain / Divided / Inset)
dontUseWhen: Rows that navigate or toggle: use ActionList with ListItem
Choosing options: use SelectionList
Many comparable records: use a Table
Hidden optional detail: use Accordion
3251:1525.a11y: ul/ol semantics for bulleted/numbered, dl for Description; Western digits in markers and values.

3254:1602.name: List / TextItem
3254:1602.description: A List text row: optional Bullet or Number marker plus the Content atom.
useWhen: Rows of List in Plain, Divided, Inset, Bulleted or Numbered styles
dontUseWhen: Key-value rows: use List / DescriptionRow
Interactive rows: use ListItem
3254:1602.a11y: Use native list markers so counts are announced.

3254:1615.name: List / DescriptionRow
3254:1615.description: Key-value row of a Description list: term and value, with a Total emphasis for the bottom line.
useWhen: Breakdown rows in List Style=Description; Emphasis=Total for net value
dontUseWhen: Single attribute pairs elsewhere: use KeyValue
Table data: use Table / Cell
3254:1615.a11y: dt/dd pairing; currency after the amount.

3241:876.name: SelectRow
3241:876.description: Selectable row with a radio or checkbox, title and description; selected state adds a brand border and tint.
useWhen: Rows inside SelectionList
Choosing a payment method or plan (Type=Radio)
Multi-choice filters or channels (Type=Checkbox)
dontUseWhen: Rows that navigate or toggle a setting: use ListItem
Bare checkbox or radio with a label: use Checkbox or Radio
3241:876.keyProps: Has leading icon, Has value, Leading icon (instance swap), Type=Radio/Checkbox, State=Unselected/Selected/Disabled, Direction=LTR/RTL
3241:876.a11y: Whole row is the radio/checkbox label; checked state exposed natively; never colour alone.

3242:866.name: SelectionList
3242:866.description: List for choosing among options: SelectRows in Single (radio, exactly one) or Multi (checkbox, any number) mode with group header and footer.
useWhen: Select payment method or bank account (Mode=Single)
Filter by asset type or notification channels (Mode=Multi)
Picking a plan with a sensible default preselected
dontUseWhen: Navigation or settings rows: use ActionList
Single on/off: use Switch
Long option lists in a form field: use Select or Combobox Field
Compact 2 to 5 short options: use SegmentedControl_2..5
3242:866.keyProps: Has header, Has footer, Mode=Single/Multi, Direction=LTR/RTL
3242:866.a11y: Single = radiogroup, Multi = group of checkboxes, both labelled by the header; never mix radio and checkbox rows.

3262:834.name: Section
3262:834.description: Section header that titles a region of a screen (above a carousel, card row or list) with optional description, leading icon, divider and a See all action. It is a heading, not a row and not a container.
useWhen: Titling a deals carousel or updates strip with a See all jump
Organising long screens into primary sections (Size=Lg) and sub-sections (Size=Md/Sm)
dontUseWhen: Collapsible content: use Accordion
Rows: use ListItem
The small header inside a grouped list: use ActionList Has header
Screen title: use AppBar
3262:834.keyProps: Title, Description, Action (text), Has description, Has action, Has leading icon, Has divider, Leading icon (instance swap), Size=Lg/Md/Sm, Direction=LTR/RTL
3262:834.a11y: Map Size to heading level (Lg h2, Md h3, Sm h4); See all link names its target (See all deals); hide it when nothing more exists.

3275:806.name: AccordionItem
3275:806.description: One collapsible disclosure row: header with title and down arrowhead, body revealed when Expanded.
useWhen: Each question of an FAQ inside Accordion
Optional detail such as terms or fee explanation
dontUseWhen: Always-visible rows: use ListItem
Region headings: use Section
3275:806.keyProps: Has leading icon, Body (text), Leading icon (instance swap), State=Collapsed/Expanded, Direction=LTR/RTL
3275:806.a11y: Header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the body region.

3276:998.name: Accordion
3276:998.description: Grouped collapsible disclosure (FAQ, terms, breakdowns) stacking AccordionItems with dividers, boxed in a card or plain.
useWhen: FAQs on deal, help or Zakah pages
Long optional content such as terms or risk detail chunked by topic
Breakdowns users open on demand
dontUseWhen: Essential info such as prices, fees, errors or key actions: keep it visible
Titling a region: use Section
Navigation lists: use ActionList
Always-visible lists: use List
3276:998.a11y: Each header a button with aria-expanded; keep one behaviour (single or multi open) per accordion.

3297:1424.name: PageIndicator
3297:1424.description: Carousel page control showing position among up to 5 slides as dots with a pill active or segmented bars. Also reused as the scroll-snap indicator.
useWhen: Under a Carousel or snap-scrolling rail (Style=Dots for a few slides)
Short ordered onboarding sets (Style=Bars)
dontUseWhen: Paged data: use Pagination
Flow progress: use Stepper or ProgressBar
3297:1424.a11y: Expose 'Slide 2 of 5'; if dots are tappable each is a button with a label; mirrors in RTL.

3299:1436.name: Carousel / Slide
3299:1436.description: One carousel slide: Standard media-over-text card or Hero full-bleed media with overlaid text, in three sizes.
useWhen: Slides inside Carousel (Type=Standard for tips or featured content, Type=Hero for promos and onboarding)
dontUseWhen: Deal cards in a strip: use CardDeal
Project update posters: use NewsCard / Poster
3299:1436.a11y: Hero overlay text must meet contrast over the darkened media; images need alt or be decorative.

3301:1742.name: Carousel
3301:1742.description: Horizontal peek strip of slides with a PageIndicator, for browsable featured content, promos and onboarding where the peek signals more.
useWhen: Featured deals, tips or learning content on home (Type=Cards)
One big promo or onboarding sequence (Type=Hero)
Paired with a Section header that offers See all
dontUseWhen: Complete or comparable lists: use List, ActionList or a Table
Critical content users must not miss: show it inline
Project update posters: use NewsCard / Poster Carousel
3301:1742.a11y: No auto-advance; provide tappable indicator or arrows besides swipe; first slide on the right in RTL.

3316:115.name: Table / Cell
3316:115.description: A transparent table cell typed by its data: Text, Numeric (end-aligned), Avatar, Tag, Status, Select, Trend and Progress, in two densities.
useWhen: Body cells of back-office and portfolio tables, one Type per column
Mobile row-as-card layouts combined with KeyValue
dontUseWhen: Column headers: use Table / HeaderCell
Row actions: use Table / ActionCell
Standalone key-value display: use KeyValue
3316:115.a11y: Use real td/th semantics; numbers in Western digits and end-aligned; Select cells need a row label.

3317:127.name: Table / HeaderCell
3317:127.description: Column header with label, optional select-all checkbox and sort state (brand arrowhead for ascending or descending).
useWhen: Header row of a data Table
Sortable columns (Sort=Asc/Desc) and bulk selection (Has select-all)
dontUseWhen: Section titles above a table: use Section
3317:127.keyProps: Label (text), Has select-all, Sort=None/Asc/Desc, Density=Default/Compact, Direction=LTR/RTL
3317:127.a11y: th scope=col with aria-sort on the sorted column; select-all checkbox labelled Select all rows.

3320:262.name: Table / ActionCell
3320:262.description: End-aligned row action cell: overflow IconButton plus optional inline ghost IconButtons. One of two identical sets with this name on the table page (this one sits in the reference container).
useWhen: Last column of back-office tables for row actions (view, edit, more)
dontUseWhen: Many actions per row: collapse them into the overflow Menu
Bulk actions: use Table / Toolbar Mode=Selection
3320:262.a11y: Each icon button labelled with action and row (Edit Riyadh Tower); overflow opens a Menu with aria-haspopup.

3322:410.name: Table / Toolbar
3322:410.description: Bar above a table with search, filter and sort controls, switching to a selection mode with the selected count and bulk actions.
useWhen: Above back-office data tables (Mode=Default)
After rows are selected to show bulk actions (Mode=Selection)
dontUseWhen: Page-level search outside tables: use Search Input
Mobile lists: use Filter menu or Bottom-sheet menu
3322:410.a11y: role=toolbar labelled for the table; result count announced in a live region when filters change.

3351:197.name: Table / ActionCell
3351:197.description: Second set named Table / ActionCell (same overflow plus inline IconButtons, same props), placed in the doc frame. Behaves identically to 3320:262; prefer one consistently.
useWhen: Row actions column in tables, same as 3320:262
dontUseWhen: Many actions per row: use the overflow Menu
Bulk actions: use Table / Toolbar Mode=Selection
3351:197.a11y: Icon buttons need labels that include the row name.

3384:9012.name: Base card
3384:9012.description: HeaderCard: the deal page hero that tops a single deal or project detail screen with the photo gallery and overlay back, share and favorite controls, qualified medallion, title, developer, meta tags and developer row; collapses to a sticky title bar (with Invest CTA on web).
useWhen: Top of a deal or project detail page, once per screen (State=Expanded)
Sticky bar while scrolling the deal page (State=Collapsed)
Web deal page using the same design widened (Platform=Web)
dontUseWhen: Deal cards in a feed or list: use CardDeal
Updates about the deal: use NewsCard
Generic screen headers: use AppBar
A separate desktop layout with breadcrumbs: keep Base card for both platforms
3384:9012.keyProps: Platform=Mobile/Web, State=Expanded/Collapsed, Has Subtitle, Has Lable, Has meta, Has developer, Direction=RTL/LTR
3384:9012.a11y: Deal title is the page h1; overlay icon buttons need labels (Back, Share, Save) and contrast over the photo; gallery counter announced (1 of 5).

3430:1350.name: NewsCard
3430:1350.description: Update card about a deal or project (status change, milestone, announcement): title and developer, update paragraph, StatusPill and last-updated date, in Plain feed, Boxed and Media (thumbnail) styles.
useWhen: Updates feed or a deal's activity list (Style=Plain, underline separates items)
A single standalone update (Style=Boxed)
Richer updates with a photo (Style=Media)
dontUseWhen: The deal itself: use CardDeal or Base card (HeaderCard)
Swipeable visual updates on the deal page: use NewsCard / Poster Carousel
System alerts: use Alert or Banner
3430:1350.keyProps: Has chevron, Has content, Style=Plain/Boxed/Media, Direction=RTL/LTR
3430:1350.a11y: Link named by the title when tappable (drop the chevron otherwise); status text not colour only; date in Western digits.

3429:917.name: NewsCard / Meta
3429:917.description: Footer line of NewsCard: StatusPill badge (for example Behind schedule) plus last-updated date.
useWhen: Bottom of NewsCard; swap the StatusPill tone and label per update status
dontUseWhen: Status inside tables: use Table / Cell Type=Status
Poster cards: use NewsCard / Poster Actions
3429:917.a11y: Date as a time element; status tone matched to meaning (warning = behind, success = on track).

5291:746.name: NewsCard / Developer Logo
5291:746.description: 32x16 developer or issuer logo slot used in NewsCard / Poster Caption, single-colour glyphs.
useWhen: Issuer logo above the poster title (Poster Caption Has logo on)
dontUseWhen: Safqah branding: use SafqahLogo
Developer rows on the deal page: use Avatar within Base card
5291:746.a11y: Alt text is the developer name, or decorative if the name appears in text.

5291:786.name: NewsCard / Poster Media
5291:786.description: Full-bleed photo for NewsCard / Poster with the frost fade, scrim and progressive blur stack that keeps the caption readable.
useWhen: Background of NewsCard / Poster; swap the photo on the Image layer
dontUseWhen: Deal card images: use CardDeal / Media
Carousel slides: use Carousel / Slide
5291:786.a11y: Decorative; the blur guarantees contrast only in the lower third, so keep text there.

5292:822.name: NewsCard / Poster Caption
5292:822.description: Text block over the poster media: optional issuer logo, title and description in inverse text.
useWhen: Caption of NewsCard / Poster; one-line title and 2 to 3 lines of description
dontUseWhen: Text on light surfaces: use Content
5292:822.keyProps: Title, Description, Has description, Has logo, Logo (instance swap), Direction=RTL/LTR
5292:822.a11y: Inverse text relies on the media blur; keep copy short so it stays in the contrast zone.

5292:170000.name: NewsCard / Poster Actions
5292:170000.description: Poster footer row: IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor) at the start (On track, Late, Construction completed) and a round open IconButton at the end.
useWhen: Footer of NewsCard / Poster (Has status, Has action)
dontUseWhen: Classic NewsCard footer: use NewsCard / Meta
5292:170000.a11y: Icon button labelled Open update; status as text; arrow points up-left in RTL.

5293:963.name: NewsCard / Poster
5293:963.description: Portrait 280x479 visual update card about a deal or project: photo, last-updated tab, issuer logo, title, description, status and open action, meant to be swiped in a carousel.
useWhen: Project updates on the deal page or home feed inside NewsCard / Poster Carousel
Construction milestones that benefit from a photo
dontUseWhen: Vertical feeds: use NewsCard (Style=Plain)
The deal itself: use CardDeal
Marketing promos: use Carousel (Type=Hero)
5293:963.a11y: Keep the status and last-updated tab so it reads as an update; card link named by the title.

5293:1456.name: NewsCard / Poster Carousel
5293:1456.description: Horizontal peek carousel of NewsCard / Poster cards at mobile content width: one full poster plus a peek of the next.
useWhen: Project updates strip on the deal page or home, under a Section header
dontUseWhen: Generic featured content: use Carousel
Long chronological update lists: use NewsCard (Style=Plain)
5293:1456.a11y: Swipe plus focusable cards; first card on the right in RTL; no auto-advance.

3946:1112.name: MenuItem
3946:1112.description: Action row of every menu: leading icon (or checkbox/radio indicator) and label, with optional submenu arrowhead and keyboard shortcut; destructive state in red.
useWhen: Rows inside Menu, Dropdown menu, Action sheet, Command palette and other menu patterns
Destructive actions fenced below a divider (State=destructive)
dontUseWhen: Persistent page rows: use ListItem
Form field options: use Dropdown Item
3946:1112.keyProps: Label (text), Icon (instance swap), Has shortcut, Shortcut (text), Has submenu, State=default/hover/disabled/destructive, Direction=ltr/rtl
3946:1112.a11y: role=menuitem (menuitemcheckbox/radio in selection menus); shortcut text stays LTR in its own node.

3948:1086.name: MenuSectionHeader
3948:1086.description: Muted label that titles a group of menu items.
useWhen: Grouping items in Menu, Command palette or Bottom-sheet menu
dontUseWhen: Page region titles: use Section
Grouped list headers: use ActionList Has header
3948:1086.a11y: Label the group (role=group with aria-labelledby); not focusable.

3948:1177.name: Menu
3948:1177.description: Floating surface listing commands (Edit, Share, Delete) with section headers and a divider before the destructive action; the base every anchored menu reuses. Menus fire commands, they do not pick form values.
useWhen: Overflow actions on a card, row or header
Context actions grouped by section
Base for building Dropdown menu, Sort menu and Filter menu
dontUseWhen: Picking a value for a form field: use Select or Multi-select field
Free-form floating content (text, links, close): use Popover
Persistent in-page rows: use ActionList
Long menus on mobile: use Action sheet or Bottom-sheet menu
3948:1177.a11y: role=menu, arrow-key navigation, Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger, outside click dismisses.

3955:1905.name: MenuTrigger
3955:1905.description: The button that opens a menu, in kebab, meatball, hamburger, bento, arrow or split glyphs; nests IconButton (split nests a Button plus an arrow IconButton).
useWhen: Opening an overflow Menu on cards, rows or headers (Glyph=kebab / meatball)
Split button with a primary action and more options (Glyph=split)
dontUseWhen: Expanding the navigation rail: use Icon / nav-toggle-menu
Plain single actions: use IconButton or Button
3955:1905.a11y: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, and an aria-label such as More options.

3966:2455.name: Dropdown menu
3966:2455.description: MenuTrigger plus Menu anchored with a placement (bottom/top x start/end); also the preset for split-button, overflow and context menus.
useWhen: Web and back-office overflow actions anchored to a button
Header actions menus (export, share, settings)
dontUseWhen: Choosing a form value: use Select
Mobile: use Action sheet
Rich content panels: use Popover
3966:2455.a11y: Focus moves into the menu on open and back to the trigger on close; start/end flip in RTL.

3968:2683.name: Cascading submenu
3968:2683.description: A child Menu flowing off a MenuItem with a submenu arrowhead, opening toward the end or start edge.
useWhen: Desktop menus with a second level such as Export > CSV / PDF
dontUseWhen: Mobile: flatten into a Bottom-sheet menu
Deep navigation: use NavigationRail or Drawer
3968:2683.a11y: Right/left arrow (mirrored in RTL) opens and closes the submenu; aria-haspopup on the parent item.

3969:2795.name: Sort menu
3969:2795.description: Selection menu of radio MenuItems for the sort field plus an ascending/descending order.
useWhen: Sorting deal lists or table views (by return, date, amount)
dontUseWhen: Sorting a single table column: use Table / HeaderCell Sort
Filtering: use Filter menu
3969:2795.a11y: menuitemradio items with aria-checked; announce the chosen order.

3970:2937.name: Filter menu
3970:2937.description: Selection menu of checkbox MenuItems with an Apply / Clear footer for filtering a list or table.
useWhen: Compact filters on back-office tables or deal lists (asset type, status)
dontUseWhen: Many filter groups: use a trailing Drawer with Sheet Content / Form
Inline in-page choices: use SelectionList (Mode=Multi)
3970:2937.a11y: menuitemcheckbox items; Apply returns focus to the trigger and announces the result count.

3972:2887.name: Command palette
3972:2887.description: Command-K search over commands: a Combobox field header with grouped MenuItem results and a no-results state.
useWhen: Power-user search across back-office actions and records
dontUseWhen: Investor mobile app: use Search Input
Picking a single form value: use Combobox Field
3972:2887.a11y: Combobox pattern with aria-activedescendant; results count and no-results announced.

3981:2871.name: Multi-select field
3981:2871.description: Form field that holds several selected values shown as chips, a count or text, paired with a checkbox menu with select-all and clear-all.
useWhen: Choosing several values in a back-office form or filter (regions, asset types)
dontUseWhen: A single value: use Select or Combobox Field
Few options visible on the page: use Checkbox Group or SelectionList (Mode=Multi)
3981:2871.a11y: Field has a visible label; chips removable by keyboard; selected count announced.

3983:2895.name: Autocomplete
3983:2895.description: Combobox field with a suggestions list that highlights the matching text, with a loading state.
useWhen: Searching a long list as the user types (bank name, investor, city)
dontUseWhen: Short fixed option lists: use Select
Global search screens: use Search Input with Search Dropdown
3983:2895.a11y: ARIA combobox with listbox; loading announced; the loading row still needs a live spinner.

3984:3215.name: Action sheet
3984:3215.description: Mobile bottom-anchored list of actions with a destructive option and Cancel; the phone form of a Menu.
useWhen: Overflow actions on mobile (share deal, cancel reservation)
Confirming a destructive choice among a few actions
dontUseWhen: Desktop: use Dropdown menu
Tasks with content or inputs: use BottomSheet
One-line confirm: use Dialog
3984:3215.a11y: Modal dialog semantics; Cancel always present and focusable; destructive action labelled clearly.

3984:3216.name: Bottom-sheet menu
3984:3216.description: Mobile menu on the BottomSheet surface: grabber, section header and a MenuItem list.
useWhen: Longer grouped menus on mobile
Flattened submenus from desktop
dontUseWhen: Choosing an option with a selected state: use SelectionList in a BottomSheet
Desktop: use Dropdown menu
3984:3216.a11y: Dialog with menu inside; close action besides drag.

3985:3145.name: FAB speed-dial
3985:3145.description: Floating action button that expands into labelled action rows.
useWhen: A few related create actions from one floating button on mobile
dontUseWhen: One primary action: use FAB / Standard or FAB / Extended
Dashboard shortcuts: use ActionTile
3985:3145.a11y: FAB has aria-expanded; each action labelled; Esc collapses.

3989:3225.name: Long-press preview
3989:3225.description: Long-press context pattern: a content preview card with a contextual action list.
useWhen: Quick actions on a deal or update card via long press on mobile
dontUseWhen: As the only path to an action: also offer a visible MenuTrigger
Desktop: use Dropdown menu (context preset)
3989:3225.a11y: Long press is not discoverable or accessible to all; mirror every action in a visible menu.
